# Version 3.116.0
> **Stable v3 release** · Released December 2, 2024 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.116.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.116.0)

> **Supersedes [3.0.0](3.0.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.116.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.116.0 is the stable v3 release, rolling up the modernized engine, APIs, and platform support. It includes the full 3.0 preview line, current WebAssembly and Blazor compatibility work, and updated Skia and HarfBuzz components.

## Breaking Changes

- **Major-version API cleanup** — The v3 API diffs contain removals across SkiaSharp and view packages. Rebuild all applications against 3.116.0 and replace removed obsolete APIs with their documented replacements.

## Engine

- **Modern Skia and HarfBuzz foundations** — The stable v3 line refreshes the bundled graphics and text-shaping engines. ([#2505](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2505), [#2539](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2539), [#2582](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2582), [#2730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2730), [#3087](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3087), [#3089](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3089))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly and Blazor compatibility improved** — Updates WebAssembly hosting, ASP.NET Blazor integration, and browser runtime compatibility. ([#3064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3064), [#3082](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3082), [#3088](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3088), [#3092](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3092))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0

Updates HarfBuzzSharp with the text-shaping work included across the v3 release line.
